summary: Govern CI/CD controls, SBOM ownership, and release exceptions with practical NIST SSDF workflows. Review the course outline and plan your training.
lede: DevSecOps governance connects software security policy with accountable control decisions across build and release workflows. For security leads, platform engineers, and product owners, the training covers mapping controls to CI/CD responsibilities, setting exception and evidence practices, and managing software supply chain risks. Participants practise reviewing SBOMs, assessing dependency and build provenance signals, and preparing release-risk reports for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who shape, operate, or approve secure software delivery controls. It is designed for intermediate practitioners who work with development, platform, security, procurement, or release teams.
prerequisites: Recommended prior knowledge: working familiarity with software development lifecycles, source control, CI/CD concepts, and basic application security. No programming is required; exercises use sample software delivery artifacts and spreadsheet-based registers.
